goal: Improve KD with new-class-aware, class-balanced pixel prediction distillation
architecture: baseline ViT-B and independent conv8 segmentation head unchanged
method: KL on main segmentation logits at native decoder resolution
teacher background matches student background+all new probabilities
PAR current-new-class pixels veto KD; strong image-label-masked new CAM softly attenuates remaining KD
normalized teacher entropy provides continuous reliability weight
global batch per-teacher-class normalization, background as one class
unchanged: historical baseline source/data/GT protocol, original pseudo labels and original padding behavior; prototype KD/SEP and ALD off
parallel_equivalence: BCE/PTC denominators and KD class counts aggregated over 8 ranks; checked against global-batch reference gradients
comparison: Existing final BASE and original KD; step1 previous10/current5, step2 previous15/current5 plus initial10/cumulative10
limitations: DDP sampling/augmentation/dropout not bitwise identical to historic single-GPU execution
Improvement is a research hypothesis, not guaranteed
performance_goal: Seek roughly +1pp overall while improving old-class retention without material new-class regression; not a promised outcome
